generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of kppp-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
For Details Refer Tender Notification And Conditions In The Bid Documents.
All materials should be in good quality as per specification, quality certificate for the same should be obtained from the concerned authority at their own cost.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval.
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
All the materials to be utilised for the work must be tested in PRED labs/ 3rd Party Consultant and Quality control test reports must be enclosed to the bills mandatorily.
If any date in the tender time table is government holiday, next working date will be considered
Executive Engineer PRED Belgaum has authority to accept or reject any tender without assigning reason
Tenderer must mandatorily submit his present accurate postal address and phone number in a signed letterhead.
The tender may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason
Tenderers must have valid PRED/PWD registration and must submit PRED/PWD registration copy
Any objection regarding the tender must be submitted directly to Executive Engineer , not in inward.
For interpretations of clauses, conditions, spelling mistakes, etc. decision of Executive Engineer, PRED, Belgaum is final.

Successful bidder submitting bids below the amount put to tender will be regularized to submit the difference amount in the form of FDR/BG/SD/Pledge on the name of EE PRED Belagavi within 15 days from the date of receiving the letter of acceptance. additional security paid for unbalanced tenders Failing which EMD will be forfeited and further action will be taken as per G O No FD PCL 2008 Bangalore Dated 14/10/2008.

As per Government order No. FD 56 PWD cell 2004, Bngalore, 18th Janury 2005, The contractor shall be made responsible for submiting e-bills duly suported the hard copy of detailed measurements of work. using electrinic spreadsheets and making computation thereof. The conctractor shall submit diskette/ CD room in addition the hard copy.

The tenderers must submit the scanned documents in pdf / jpeg form, not in other form and which are should not be corrupted files. If it shows errors while opening the documents the employer is not responsible. Hence the such files will be considerd as un submitted.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25, & 2025-26 achieved in One financial year should be more than financial turnover of Rs. 5.06Lakhs (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only)

The Tenderer shall obtain Similar Nature of Work done certificate will be Considered financial years of 2021-22 to 2025-26 (50% of the Amount Put to Tender) i.e Rs.2.53lakhs in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer) and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid.

Tenderer must have liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30% amount Put to Tender (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. for three months of Rs.1.52Lakhs (LOC letter should be unconditional format)
THIS WORK IS RANDOMISED AS OTHER WORK.
Single Tender Will Not Be Accepted
Bidder should submit completed work, Work done certificate if in case they submit the workdone certificate as on ongoing work. Such Bidder will be disqualified
Ongoing works: Bidder shall compulsorily submit details of all PHYSICAL ONGOING WORKS on their official letterhead, duly signed & stamped. NIL declaration shall result in disqualification.
Mandatory site visit: Bidder/Contractor shall compulsorily upload a GPS-tagged site photograph showing data, time & location before bidding failure to submit shall result in rejection of the bid.
Related Document: As soon as LOA will be sent to contractor login, within 15days submit back by attaching required document. If failed to attach tender will be cancelled & retendered.
Working methodology: Before finalising L1, the bidder shall submit a work methodology & resource plan for department of screutiny & approval.

itemList.description: Earth work excavation for pipelines/cables by Manual means upto 600 mm trench width, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,  shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or leveling the excavated earth or sorting &  stacking the selected  earth for reuse in a radius of  50 m. Depth upto 1.50m,Details of laying of cost for 60m length of a pipe of an average dia. say 450mm. Slope assumed 1 in 200. Earth work and filling - Minimum depth of trench with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing   Flush/ Ruled pointing: Pointing on stone work with cement mortar 1:3 (1 cement : 3 fine sand)  after raking joints to depth nicely lining, including cost of materials, labour, curing as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and laying in Cement Concrete  for all Basement & surface level  works, return walls, retaining walls, sunken floors etc. The  granite/trap/ basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle  vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all  other  appurtenances   required to complete the work as per technical  specifications.  M25 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing 12 mm cement plaster with cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement: 6 fine sand) to brick masonry including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.
